decisions.reason: As a core finishing machine close to the established portfolio, the perfect binder fits the firm's service-led wholesale model and supports its aim to offer complete post-press solutions to print providers.
The fully automatic perfect binder directly matches the firm's stated focus on automation, productivity and reduced downtime, so it should be retained as a strategic growth product.
The inline and nearline booklet maker strengthens the firm's digital print finishing offering and complements its broad installed-base, training and spare-parts business.
